name: Wavo Health
description: Wavo Health is an AI clinical workspace that turns patient conversations into notes, visit prep, patient context, coding cues, and follow-up content. Claims to save 50% of documentation time. Pricing not publicly listed—offers Pro tier for individuals and Enterprise for larger groups. Free trial available ('Try Wavo Free'). Supports SOAP, consult, progress notes, and specialty templates plus coding cues, patient summaries, letters, and exports. Mental health specialty support mentioned. Best for practices wanting a comprehensive AI workspace beyond pure scribing. Requires contact for specific pricing.

faqs.q: How much does Wavo Health cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Wavo Health does not publicly list pricing. They offer Pro (individual) and Enterprise (groups) tiers. Contact their sales team for quotes. A free trial is available to test the platform.

faqs.q: What makes Wavo Health different from other AI scribes?
faqs.a: Wavo Health positions itself as an 'AI clinical workspace' rather than just an AI scribe. It includes visit prep, patient context, coding cues, and follow-up content alongside ambient documentation—a more comprehensive workflow tool.

faqs.q: Does Wavo Health have a free trial?
faqs.a: Yes. Wavo Health offers 'Try Wavo Free' to test the platform. Teams can use a 'champion week' free trial to evaluate before committing.

faqs.q: Does Wavo Health support mental health documentation?
faqs.a: Wavo Health mentions mental health specialty support. However, for purpose-built mental health tools, therapists may prefer Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo). Contact Wavo for specific mental health capabilities.

faqs.q: Wavo Health vs Freed: which is better?
faqs.a: Freed ($39-119/mo) has transparent pricing and proven mental health support. Wavo Health has undisclosed pricing but offers a broader workspace approach (visit prep, coding cues, follow-up). If you prefer transparent pricing, Freed. If you want comprehensive workspace features, try Wavo's free trial.
